name: Lies & Marriage
source:
Meet Arisu, a clumsy but endearing 23-year-old girl who works as a secretary at a company. Unfortunately, according to her family's long-standing tradition, every woman must be married by the age of 25 - and time is running out. Desperate but hopeful, Arisu and her best friend attend a singles ball, the perfect chance to meet her future husband… or so she thinks. There, she meets new and familiar faces: a charming singer, a dedicated police officer, a confident bartender, a famous celebrity, a childhood friend, a philosophical journalist, and even... a fortune teller?

...But is that really true? A mysterious fortune teller claims that 9 of these men are liars. Who’s telling the truth — and who’s hiding something?

[From [url=https://imagia.itch.io/liesandmarriage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来认识一下Arisu，一个笨拙但可爱的23岁女孩，在一家公司担任秘书。不幸的是，根据她家族长期以来的传统，每个女性都必须在25岁之前结婚——而时间已经不多了。有栖和她最好的朋友绝望而又充满希望地参加了一场单身舞会，这是认识她未来丈夫的绝佳机会……至少她是这么认为的。在那里，她遇到了熟悉的新面孔：迷人的歌手、敬业的警察、自信的调酒师、著名的名人、儿时的朋友、哲学记者，甚至……算命先生？

……但这真的是真的吗？一位神秘的算命师声称其中9个人都是骗子。谁说的是真话，谁在隐瞒什么？

[来自[url=https://imagia.itch.io/liesandmarriage]itch.io[/url]]
